headline: House resolution to impeach President Trump for allegedly taking Congress's power to declare war was tabled and did not pass.
what_it_does: This resolution would have impeached President Donald Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors. It contained one article of impeachment, which said the President abused his powers by taking over Congress's constitutional power to declare war. If the House had adopted it, the case would have gone to the Senate for a trial. On June 24, 2025, the House voted to table it, which set it aside.

who_it_affects.how: He would have been formally impeached by the House and faced a Senate trial that could lead to removal from office.
They would have been required to hold a trial and vote on whether to convict and remove the President.
